title: ON THE CLOSE INTERACTION BETWEEN ALGORITHMIC RANDOMNESS AND CONSTRUCTIVE/COMPUTABLE MEASURE THEORY
reasoning: The paper discusses various constructive mathematical traditions (Brouwerian intuitionism, Russian constructivism, Bishop's constructivism, Martin-Löf's approach, reverse mathematics) as foundational approaches to measure theory. These are distinct epistemological positions in mathematics. However, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark them in the context of religion, faith, morals, or ethics. It focuses on their mathematical and computational implications for measure theory.
